name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) is a life insurance scheme offering term life insurance cover for death due to any reason. It is a one-year cover, renewable year to year, offered by banks and post offices and administered through life insurance companies. Individuals who are account holders of participating banks or post offices and are aged 18 to 50 years are entitled to join.
aliases: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefits: One-year term life cover of ₹2,00,000 for subscribers aged 18-50 years.
Death due to any reason is covered under the scheme.
Premium is ₹436 per annum per subscriber, auto-debited from the subscriber's bank or post office account.

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Applicant must be at most 50 years old.
Applicant must hold an individual bank or post office account with a participating bank or post office.

tutorial_steps.title: Download the application form
tutorial_steps.description: Download and print the Consent-cum-Declaration Form from https://www.jansuraksha.gov.in/Files/PMJJBY/English/ApplicationForm.pdf.

tutorial_steps.title: Fill and sign the form
tutorial_steps.description: Fill in all required details and sign the application form.

tutorial_steps.title: Attach required documents
tutorial_steps.description: Attach self-attested copies of required documents.

tutorial_steps.title: Submit to Bank or Post Office
tutorial_steps.description: Submit the completed form and documents to an authorised official of the Bank or Post Office.

tutorial_steps.title: Receive acknowledgement
tutorial_steps.description: The official returns the Acknowledgement Slip-cum-Certificate of Insurance after processing the application.
